class.name: OcgTdatastdBytearray
class.brief_description: An array of Byte (unsigned char) values.
class.description: ! An array of Byte (unsigned char) values.

method.name: Init
method.description: Initialize the inner array with bounds from <lower> to <upper>

method.name: SetValue
method.description: Sets the <Index>th element of the array to <Value> OutOfRange exception is raised if <Index> doesn't respect Lower and Upper bounds of the internal array.

method.name: SetID_2
method.description: Sets the explicit GUID (user defined) for the attribute.

method.name: SetID_1
method.description: Sets default GUID for the attribute.

method.name: Value
method.description: Return the value of the <Index>th element of the array.

method.name: Lower
method.description: Returns the lower boundary of the array.

method.name: Upper
method.description: Returns the upper boundary of the array.

method.name: Length
method.description: Returns the number of elements in the array.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: GetID
method.description: Static methods ============== Returns an ID for array.

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Finds or creates an attribute with the array on the specified label. If <isDelta> == False, DefaultDeltaOnModification is used. If <isDelta> == True, DeltaOnModification of the current attribute is used. If attribute is already set, all input parameters are refused and the found attribute is returned.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Finds or creates an attribute with byte array and explicit user defined <guid> on the specified label.
